name: newpipe-music-web
description: A NewPipe-inspired music web app built with React, youtubei.js and yt-dlp.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
